name: Lightning Bolt
description:
Uncheck a Condition. If you did, roll Spirit vs Dexterity against a creature within long range. On a win, it takes 3d6 damage. On a loss, half damage.

If the unchecked Condition was Angry, +1d damage.

Describe the lightning.
successes:
✨: +1d to the first damage roll for this ability.

🌞: +1d to all damage rolls for this ability.

improvements.name: Chain Lightning
improvements.description: On a win, you may chain this attack to another creature within short range of the previous target. Roll Spirit vs Dexterity. On a win, the target takes 2d6 damage and you may continue chaining. On a loss, the target takes half damage and the chain ends.

improvements.name: Ball Lightning
improvements.description:
For the initial attack, you may instead target any number of creatures in a straight line reaching out to long range, using the same roll and triggering the same effect on each win.

If you have the Chain Lightning advancement, you may chain outward from each individual win.
